additions.reason: The Rebbe states explicitly: 'גם יש רשעים שהם בחינת ערב רב, וכשהם נופלים על הלב, דהינו על ישראל, זה גם כן בחינת עפרוריות.' The wicked who are a bechina of ערב רב ARE ALSO a bechina of עפרוריות when they fall on Israel's heart. This is a direct bechina equating ערב רב with עפרוריות — they share the essential nature of 'that which smothers Israel's inner fire.' ערב רב is the social/human form of the same obstruction that מרה שחורה is in the psychological form. This node is missing from the dataset entirely (no edge for reference 1009 connects ערב רב). It belongs in Package 3 alongside עפרוריות and מרה שחורה.

additions.reason: The Tikkun Zohar passage that opens the Torah describes 'כנפי ריאה דנשבין על לבא' — the lobes of the lung that blow on the heart. This is the physical-anatomical bechina undergirding the entire metaphor: just as the lung-wings blow on the heart and regulate its heat, so the leaders blow their spirit on Israel's heart. כנפי ריאה is a neutral structural node (a body part serving as the metaphor-anchor). It is missing from the dataset for reference 1009. It belongs most naturally in Package 1 (Israel/heart) as the physical counterpart to the heart, or as a bridge node between Package 1 and Package 2.

analysis_notes.good_evil_mirror_structure: The Torah has a clean double-polarity mirror: Package 2 (מנהיגי הדור / רוח — good measured wind) is mirrored by Package 4 (רוח סערה — destructive unmeasured wind); Package 1 (ישראל / לבא — the good heart that burns) is mirrored by Package 3 (עפרוריות / מרה שחורה — the smothering force that extinguishes the heart). The good wind fans the good heart; the evil obstruction smothers it; the evil storm over-inflames it.
